topic: Mathar's recurrence conjecture of 30 November 2012 in the FORMULA field of OEIS A084261
title: Weighted extensions of Jovovic's 2003 formula: resolving Mathar's conjecture (OEIS A084261, FORMULA, 30 November 2012)

creators.name: Zhang, Wenlin
creators.affiliation: National University of Singapore; ChronoAI Pte Ltd, Singapore

abstract: We give an alternative proof of Jovovic's 2003 exponential generating function and resolve Mathar's Conjecture in OEIS A084261, FORMULA, 30 November 2012, for every integer n >= 3. For a(n,t)=sum binomial(n,2k) k! t^(n-2k), the fixed-point-weighted generating function of Fang, Hamaker and Troyka (2020; journal version 2022) yields an explicit polynomial recurrence. A common moment representation also proves the recorded row sums, continued fraction, Hankel product and asymptotic equivalent, the last extending to every fixed real t > 0.
summary: A self-contained proof of the recurrence, explicit weighted consequences, and proofs of the directly related OEIS formulas with their original attributions.

coverage.universal_recurrence: All natural n >= 3; declaration D5.S1.Recurrence.MatharA084261.result in the pinned Lean file.
coverage.weighted_recurrence: Polynomial identity in t for all n >= 3; written proof.
coverage.exponential_generating_function: Entire identity; written proof of the Jovovic (2003) formula. Weighted factorization credited to Fang-Hamaker-Troyka (2020; 2022).
coverage.triangle: A161556 row polynomials, row sums and column exponential generating functions; written proof.
coverage.continued_fraction: Formal Jacobi fraction with diagonal t and beta(r)=ceil(r/2); written proof. Hanna (2006) formula at t=1; general transformation proof credited to Barry (2009), Propositions 4 and 22.
coverage.hankel: For all n >= 0 and real t, determinant of (a(i+j,t)) equals product ceil(r/2)^(n+1-r); written proof of the A137704 formula.
coverage.asymptotic: For each fixed real t > 0, a(n,t) ~ sqrt(pi*n)/2 * (n/(2e))^(n/2) * exp(t*sqrt(2n)-t^2/2), through all integer n; written proof. Rousseau (2006) formula at t=1.
coverage.appell: Derivative of a(n,t) is n*a(n-1,t); written consequence.
coverage.signed_fixed_points: For independently signed fixed points, summed over sign imbalances, c(n)=a(n,2); recurrence and asymptotic specialization have written proofs. Interpretation credited to Fang-Hamaker-Troyka Section 5.1.
coverage.finite_checks: 881 sequence values, 590 weighted integer instances, 118 polynomial recurrence identities, 120 Appell identities, 305 row evaluations, 305 moment coefficients, 70 Hankel determinants; exact arithmetic.
